title: On wellposedness and limiting behavior of generalized SQG equations
summary: We consider the two-dimensional generalized surface quasi-geostrophic equations in $\mathbb{R}^2$, given by \[\partial_t θ+u\cdot \nabla θ=0,\quad u=-\nabla^{\perp}Λ^{β-2}θ,\,β\in [1,2).\] When $β=1$, the equation defines the SQG equation and for $β>1$, it defines a family of more singular active scalar equations. We prove that if the interval of existence of the smooth solution to the generalized SQG equations for some $β_0\in[1,2)$ is $[0,T]$, then with the same initial data, the interval of existence of the generalized SQG equations for $β$ close to $β_0$ also contains $[0,T]$.
